questions.prompt: Why is `unserialize($userInput)` dangerous in PHP even if you don't call any methods on the returned value?

options.text: Object instantiation (`__wakeup`, `__destruct`, `__toString`) can trigger 'POP gadget chains' leading to remote code execution

questions.prompt: Why must `password_hash()` and `password_verify()` be used instead of `sha256($password)`?

options.text: Fast hashes like SHA-256 can be brute-forced at billions of guesses/sec on GPUs, whereas `password_hash` uses salted, slow adaptive algorithms

options.text: `'expires' => 0` with `httponly => false` so JS can read session IDs

questions.prompt: Why should you call `session_regenerate_id(true)` right after a user logs in?

options.text: To prevent session fixation attacks by issuing a fresh session ID and deleting the old one

questions.prompt: What does `OPcache` (`opcache.enable=1`) do in production PHP?

options.text: Caches compiled PHP opcode bytecode in shared memory so PHP doesn't re-parse/compile `.php` files on every request

questions.prompt: What does `composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader` achieve in a production Docker/deploy build?

options.text: Excludes dev tools (PHPUnit/PHPStan) and builds a classmap for faster PSR-4 autoloading

questions.prompt: What is the risk of `include $_GET['page'] . '.php';`?

options.text: Local/Remote File Inclusion (LFI/RFI) and path traversal allowing arbitrary code execution

options.text: To prevent leaking stack traces, file paths, and DB details to attackers while recording errors in server logs

questions.prompt: Why should outbound HTTP clients (cURL / Guzzle) always configure explicit connect and request timeouts?

options.text: PHP has no default timeout on some streams or defaults to 60s, which can exhaust all PHP-FPM workers when an upstream hangs

questions.prompt: What is a common cause of `memory_limit` exhaustion when exporting 200,000 database rows to CSV in PHP?

questions.prompt: Why can `foreach ($items as &$item)` followed later by `foreach ($items as $item)` cause a notorious PHP bug?
